module: GPS Vehicle Tracking › Grid View card action pop-ups
requirement: Fix the pop-up that appears when the Live, History, Reports etc. icons on the Grid View vehicle cards are clicked

rounds.text: Nearby popup redesigned like the Vehicle Overview screenshot, with a slim header
Vehicle info card on the map now uses the existing Tracking info card (Live Track and Nearby)
Nearby: map and Vehicle Overview as separate sections, compact overview showing 4 vehicles, light map like the screenshot
Glassy Vehicle Overview panel; selected vehicle shows only its number, bigger picture
Gradient status pill for the selected vehicle
Selected vehicle picture back to its earlier size
Vehicle pictures trimmed so all vehicles show at the same size
Solid white Overview panel with header divider; selected nearby card with Map View green outline; 6px section spacing in all popups
Ripple animation on the selected vehicle pin (Nearby map), all pins one size; popup inner padding 8px, section gaps 6px
Pins back to the earlier small size (28px, all the same); Vehicle Overview panel 8px inner spacing
Ripple colour follows the selected vehicle's status
Subtle shadows on the Vehicle Overview panel sections
Selected pin outline uses the status colour
Speedometer colours follow the vehicle status, as in the app's Speedometer
Developer's Nearby Vehicles and Vehicle details icons on the card buttons and in the popups
Info card content and alignment from screenshot (plate column, date, operator, ID, location); map summary chips on Live and History; History timeline bar with 1x-8x; date range as a map button
Live Track: TODAY row removed (figures stay on the map chips)
Info card: date back in the gradient tab top-left; ID and location aligned
Live Track / History: information row removed; map redraws on size change
Info card: location in dark text
Map chips shorter (24px); ID icon removed from the info card
Info card date tab uses the status gradient
Slim header with popup name on all six popups; vehicle info card added to Track History, following playback
Info card: date tab and speedometer always share one status (Live, History playback, Nearby); operator/ID moved up with a gap above location
Same design on the Tracking page (info card, map chips, History timeline in the header, pin ripple) and Map View (pins one size, selected pin ripples in its status colour)
History only: Selected History Dates column (scroll) in the info card when 2+ dates are selected, popup and Tracking page
History dates column: full date and time range visible, section moved to the top
Timeline handle smaller (10px), popup and Tracking page
All popups: header divider removed, sections start right under the header, white popup body
Popup headers carry the card's action icons (current one active); Vehicle Overview: lighter inner shadows, shadow on the whole panel
Minimised info card: speed in status colour with expand icon, stays minimised across vehicles/popups; header icons light green outline
Popup headers: status as tinted chip (Live Tracking / History, Vehicle Details)
Vehicle details icon on green tiles: no black, white badge with green 'i'
All popups the Live Monitor size (1240 x 720)
Nearby panel top shadow no longer cropped; same section shadow on every popup's sections
Filter panel (Map View, Tracking): long toggle headings on one line; panel opens left of the filter button, top-aligned
Vehicle Details: info tiles, Device & Health, Sensors, and 5 charts (activity timeline, odometer, top speed by day, alert summary, operator performance); no shadow on Live/Nearby maps
